primary_audience: Prospective parents, gifted secondary students, and international baccalaureate applicants

aesthetic_direction.typography: Refined humanist serif headers (e.g. Garamond or EB Garamond) paired with approachable geometric sans (e.g. Plus Jakarta Sans)
aesthetic_direction.composition: Story-driven sections with clear academic calendar rails, multi-stage application pathways, and authentic student voice vignettes

media_guidelines: Candid documentary-style photography of real classroom engagement, lab experiments, and outdoor sports. Authentic expressions without posed smiles.
anti_patterns: Overly rigid corporate tables without context
Stock photos of unrelated models in graduation gowns
Unlabeled tuition costs hidden behind friction walls
